task: Compact article validation on existing matched public HG005 results

primary.selection: Shared completed WGS regression chromosomes; identical across cases. Availability-constrained and previously exposed, not random selection or independent validation.

secondary.kind: Existing all-autosome target-only counts; includes development and training chromosomes; descriptive, no new genome calling

missing: QUILT2 WGS chr18/20 unavailable and QUILT2 INDEL unsupported; no substitution

bootstrap.scope: Conditional on observed individual and regions, not across-person confidence; no multiplicity-adjusted superiority claim

timing.component: Full apply44 filter function including depth profile, VCF IO and hashes; not native calling
timing.check: Exact per-record and compressed-output SHA, invariant hash, accepted/rejected counts

draft_protocol_deviation: Earlier 64Mb/two-person design was not a registered or executed experiment. This bounded stage verifies the available chr18/20 benchmark and target subset with regional uncertainty; independent eligible people have not been established.
